dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: How's Bennett been doing the past few days?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's been having a great time with the rest of us! Speaking of which... His sudden lucky streak wouldn't have anything to do with you, would it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, you and your non-answers! At this rate, Paimon should've named you "Acts-coy-to-avoid-giving-any-actual-answers Bard" instead!
